other_accessions_not_analyzed.GSE200501: scRNA-seq of pooled TA muscles (3 Pax7Cre + 3 miR-501dMP pooled), CTX regeneration; no exercise arm (S2.17.p1, S11.p1)

assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NovaSeq 6000, 100 bp SE; STAR + featureCounts), tibialis anterior (S2.18.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of myogenic-progenitor-specific miR-501 deletion (miR-501dMP vs Pax7Cre control) on TA gene expression at day 6 after cardiotoxin injury (S3.3.p1, FIG3 e). This is a genotype effect during injury-induced regeneration, not an exercise effect.
constant_conditions: 12-week-old male mice; all TA muscles CTX-injected and harvested at day 6 (S2.2.p1, FIG3 e)
planned_contrasts: miR-501dMP vs Pax7Cre, TA day 6 post-CTX (S3.3.p1, FIG3 e; paper: 146 up, 89 down = 235 DEGs at p<0.05)
exercise_in_paper: A single bout of eccentric (downhill) treadmill exercise (S2.5.p1) was applied to naive miR-501dMP and Pax7Cre mice and assessed only histologically (Evans blue dye, Table 1, FIG4 c). No sequencing was performed on exercised muscle.
paper_method: not stated (no DE tool named; S2.18.p1 names STAR alignment and Enrichr GO only)
